issues.issue: beginning_cash and ending_cash hold the governmental fund balances that the statement rolls forward (cash + investments + due from funds - due to funds), not cash. This is defensible because p4-5 roll forward fund balances, but the label differs. Governmental cash plus investments at year end is 1,561,489.

The Statement of Activities (p2) puts culture and recreation operating grants and contributions at 126,912, but the culture funds' intergovernmental revenue is only 19,167 (Library 5,563 + Park & Rec 13,604). So about 107,745 of Park & Rec 'Miscellaneous' is likely donations/contributions. No breakdown is printed, so a split isn't allowed and 'other' with review stands. Same for detail[50].
